title: Ethical Hacker/Penetration Tester Roadmap
summary: Build strong foundations in networking, Linux, web applications and security testing, then progress from authorised labs to professional penetration-testing engagements.

facts.Timeline assumption: This roadmap assumes a four-year B.Tech/B.E. programme beginning in 2026 and graduating around 2030. Shift the years if your programme has a different duration.

about.label: Career-route check
about.text: Ethical Hacker/Penetration Tester is a direct career path for CSE - Cyber Security.

blocks.label: Important
blocks.text: Perform security testing only against systems you own or have explicit permission to test. Use intentionally vulnerable labs for practice.
4-year honours variant

Use an additional honours year for a substantial security-testing dissertation, advanced application/cloud security, security research or a longer industry placement. The additional year is not automatically required for an entry-level penetration-testing role.

blocks.label: Evolve and stay relevant, 2035–2046
blocks.text: Move from executing individual tests to designing assessment methodologies, leading red-team engagements, validating cloud and application architectures, automating repetitive testing and explaining technical risk to senior stakeholders.

blocks.text: PhD routes

Senior penetration testers can remain relevant by moving from individual vulnerability discovery toward security architecture, adversary simulation, cloud and application-security strategy, security research and technical leadership. Continue developing testing methodology while understanding how defensive teams detect and remediate the weaknesses you identify.
